speaker: emma
korean: 와, 예쁘다. 여기가 사진에서 본 그 카페구나.

translations.en: Wow, it's beautiful. So this is the cafe I saw in the photo.
Hello! Welcome.
Hello... um, this is my first time here.
Excuse me, what is this?
Oh, that's a dalgona latte. It's sweet!
Do you have it iced?
Yes, we do!
Then I'll have an iced dalgona latte, please.
Mmm, delicious! Today I ordered in Korean.

speaker: emma
korean: 사람이 진짜 많다. 나 길 잃은 것 같아.

translations.en: There are so many people. I think I'm lost.

speaker: emma
korean: 저기요, 경복궁에 가고 싶어요. 어떻게 가요?

translations.en: Excuse me, I want to go to Gyeongbokgung. How do I get there?
Transfer to Line 3 here.

speaker: jisu
korean: 어? 에마! 나도 그쪽으로 가는데, 같이 가자!

translations.en: Huh? Emma! I'm headed that way too — let's go together!
Jisu! Fancy meeting you here!
Then where do I board the subway?

speaker: jisu
korean: 먼저 카드부터 사자. 여기 누르면 돼.

translations.en: Let's buy a card first. Just press here.
Wow, look outside!

speaker: jisu
korean: 예쁘지? 이 다리 지날 때가 제일 좋아.

translations.en: Pretty, right? Crossing this bridge is the best part.
It smells amazing! What's that?
That's fish cake. They give you broth with it.
I want to eat tteokbokki and fish cake.
Great, let's order both!

speaker: emma
korean: 매워요! 저 매운 거 잘 못 먹어요…

translations.en: It's spicy! I can't really eat spicy food...
Drink some water!

speaker: merchant
korean: 그럼 이 튀김 먹어 봐. 하나도 안 매워.

translations.en: Then try this fritter. Not spicy at all.
Thank you!

speaker: emma
korean: 이건 정말 맛있어요! 순대하고 김밥도 먹고 싶어요.

translations.en: This one is really good! I want to try sundae and gimbap too.
Let's come again!

speaker: minjun
korean: 여기 삼겹살이 진짜야. 오늘은 내가 살게.

translations.en: The samgyeopsal here is the real deal. I'll treat you today.
Wow, thank you!

speaker: emma
korean: 지수 씨는 여기 와 본 적 있어요?

translations.en: Jisu, have you been here before?
Yeah, I come often. Everything's good.
What's the best? Please recommend something.
Half samgyeopsal, half moksal is popular.

speaker: emma
korean: 그럼 그걸로 주세요. 가위도 주실 수 있어요?

translations.en: Then we'll take that. Could you give us scissors too?
You flip the meat like this.
I'm learning everything from start to finish!
Wow, it's so good!
I'm so happy today.
This is a noraebang!
I really like noraebang.
I'll go first!
Wow... she sounds like a singer!
May I sing one too?
Of course! Here's the mic.
Emma, would you like to sing with me?
Yes! The lyrics go by so fast!

speaker: emma
korean: 목이 아파요. 근데 또 오고 싶어요.

translations.en: My throat hurts. But I want to come again.
Next time let's bring Minjun too!
This is a traditional market.
It's much more fun than a supermarket!
The fruit here is cheap and good.
I've never seen any of this. It's amazing!
Here, try one of these.

speaker: emma
korean: 우와, 달아요! 이거 조금만 더 주세요.

translations.en: Wow, it's sweet! Could I have a little more?
How much is this?
Ten thousand won. That's a good price.
Could you give me a small discount?
Haha, eight thousand then!
The market is so much better than a supermarket.
There are so many cosmetics here.
I don't know where to start.
Have you tried this sheet mask?
No, not yet.

speaker: emma
korean: 저는 피부가 건조해요. 어떤 게 좋아요?

translations.en: My skin is dry. Which one would be good?

speaker: staff
korean: 이 토너나 이 크림이 잘 맞으실 거예요.

translations.en: This toner or this cream should suit you.

speaker: sophie
korean: 이건 가족한테 주거나 친구한테 줘도 좋아요.

translations.en: This is good for giving to family or friends.
Then I'll get one too.
We bought a lot today!
Korean cosmetics are dangerous.
Okay, let's spread it out here!
The Han River is wider than I expected!
Delivery is fast in Korea.
I'm already hungry!
Mmm, so crispy! This is the best.
The sky is pretty like a painting.
The sunset here is the prettiest.
It's getting a bit cold.
It's fine. I'm glad we're all together.
Emma! Over here!
Jisu! I'm so nervous.
Now, I'll introduce our new student.
Emma, please come to the front.
Hello. I'm from the United States.
My Korean is still not very good.
I look forward to studying with you.
Your Korean is good, though!
My heart is still pounding. But I did it.
Emma, what did you do yesterday?
I went to the Han River.
I took so many photos too.
But it was my first time having chicken... and it was a bit salty.
How was it? It was still fun, right?
Yes! That sunset was the best part.
There are so many people!
This place must be famous.

speaker: emma
korean: 한 시간은 기다려야 할 것 같아요.

translations.en: I think we'll have to wait an hour.
I wonder if this one is the best.
That one's probably better.
Oh, a table opened up! Let's go in!
The wait was worth it!

speaker: jisu
korean: 시험 일주일 남았어. 오늘은 공부해야 해.

translations.en: The exam is in a week. We have to study today.
The library is nice because it's quiet.
Ah, this is exhausting...

speaker: jisu
korean: 너무 오래 앉아 있지 마. 좀 움직여.

translations.en: Don't sit too long. Move around a bit.
Put your phone in your bag. So you can focus!
Don't forget tomorrow either!
Yes, I'll definitely come!
Sophie, what do you think of tteokbokki?

speaker: sophie
korean: 음… 저는 너무 매울 것 같아요.

translations.en: Hmm... I think it'll be too spicy for me.

speaker: emma
korean: 처음엔 저도 그랬어요. 근데 지금은 좋아해요!

translations.en: I was the same at first. But now I love it!

speaker: sophie
korean: 맞는 말이에요. 근데 저는 좀 달라요.

translations.en: You have a point. But I'm a little different.
Jisu said the spicier the better.
Oh? It's better than I expected!
Right?
Minjun, have you been to Jeju Island?

speaker: minjun
korean: 응, 작년에 갔어. 바다가 진짜 예뻐.

translations.en: Yeah, I went last year. The sea is so beautiful.
Wow, I want to go too!

speaker: minjun
korean: 시험 끝난 후에 가면 딱 좋아. 꼭 가 봐.

translations.en: Right after exams is perfect. You should definitely go.

speaker: emma
korean: 꼭 가 보세요, 라고 저도 말할 날이 오겠죠?

translations.en: Someday I'll be the one saying "you should go," right?
Sophie, what are you watching these days?

speaker: emma
korean: 이 드라마 진짜 좋아요. 완전 빠져들었어요.

translations.en: This drama is so good. I'm completely hooked.
I want to watch it too!
I'll sleep as soon as it's over...

speaker: sophie
korean: 밤새 다 봤어요! 다음 화가 기대돼요!

translations.en: I watched it all night! I can't wait for the next episode!
Emma, do you know this song?

speaker: emma
korean: 어디서 들어 봤어요! 근데 가사가 무슨 뜻이에요?

translations.en: I've heard it somewhere! But what do the lyrics mean?
It keeps playing in my head. It's so catchy!
For me, it's only him!
There's a concert next month!
Wow, let's go together!

speaker: emma
korean: 한국 사람들은 피부 관리 어떻게 해요?

translations.en: How do Korean people take care of their skin?
Does this sheet mask actually work?
Yes, the reviews are excellent.
How's this color?
It suits you!
This isn't as expensive as I thought.
Today was a total success!

speaker: emma
korean: 민준 씨, 운동 얼마나 자주 해요?

translations.en: Minjun, how often do you work out?
I've been walking every day for three years.

speaker: emma
korean: 저도 요즘 스트레칭 꾸준히 하고 있어요.

translations.en: I've been stretching regularly these days too.
Walking is the best thing for your health.
Let's walk together tomorrow too!
Jisu, where do you live?
Near Hongdae. We're headed there now!
The alleys are so pretty!
Do you live alone?
Yeah, it's been two years since I came here.
What's near your place?
A convenience store and a cafe!
This must be a great place to live.
Emma, how have you been feeling lately?
My Korean is improving these days, so I'm happy!

speaker: emma
korean: 다음 주에 발표가 있거든요. 좀 설레요.

translations.en: I have a presentation next week, you see. I'm a little excited.
I was really nervous back then too...

speaker: emma
korean: 괜찮아요, 지수 씨. 저도 옆에 있을게요.

translations.en: It's okay, Jisu. I'll be right beside you.
Thanks. You've really grown.
Jisu, are you okay?
She's quieter than usual today.
Things have been a bit hard lately...
I couldn't even sleep because I was working on assignments.
Call me anytime. I'll listen.
Thanks... I feel a little better.
Minjun, do you use KakaoTalk?
I have Instagram too! This is my account.
What's your ID? I'll save it.
May I follow you?

speaker: minjun
korean: 당연하지! 사진 좋은 거 있으면 보내 줄게.

translations.en: Of course! If I get a good shot, I'll send it to you.
I gained one follower!
The sundubu here is famous. Let's go in!
What do you want? I'll order.
I'll treat you today!
Huh? Really?
Then should we split the bill?
Next time, contact me first.
Let's grab a meal together again!
This is a hanbok rental place.
Emma, have you ever worn a hanbok?
What does this mean?
As you can see, each pattern has its own meaning.
What do people in Korea do on holidays?
Let's take lots of photos!
Minjun, do you drink?
A little! Today let's all have a drink.
Cheers!
Eat some food too! This is the best.
My face is burning up...
Let's stop here for today!
Let's sing this song together!
Emma, you're good at this!
Any requests? I'll queue it up.
Please put in the next song too!
I'm losing my voice!
One more song!
This is the dance studio.
Start with your feet like this. Be careful not to fall!
Let me dance with you!
Ah! I almost fell!
It's hard but fun!
You'll improve as you go. You're doing great!
This place has a nice atmosphere.
Do you have anything sweet?
That window seat over there is empty.
I've been here three hours already...
Excuse me, is it okay to stay a long time here?
Let's study here again next time!
It's already been half a year since you came to Korea.
At first everything felt strange...
How about now?
I've gotten used to it now!
Korea and the U.S. differ right from how people greet each other.
Still, it's fun that every country is different.
This feels like my place now.
Jisu, do you have time today?
I have a presentation today, and I'm so nervous.
I went to bed late last night, so I'm a bit tired.
We don't have time, so let's hurry!

speaker: emma
korean: 떨리지만 잘할 수 있을 것 같아요.

translations.en: I'm nervous, but I think I can do well.
That's the spirit! You got this!
What should we do this weekend?
How about we try going here?
Great! I hope the weather is nice too.
I'll go even if it rains!
So we just meet at ten?
Perfect!
I overslept and now I'm late!
Sorry! I was late because of the subway.
It's fine. I just got here too.
This one is spicier than that one.
Thanks to you, I ate well!
Next time let's go somewhere even better.

speaker: emma
korean: 저는 음악 들으면서 걷는 거 좋아해요.

translations.en: I like walking while listening to music.

speaker: emma
korean: 자기 전에 항상 한국 노래를 들어요.

translations.en: I always listen to Korean songs before bed.
I study after having coffee.
I memorize words while I'm walking.
As soon as I go out, I'll stop by the convenience store.
Our habits are similar!

speaker: jisu
korean: 에마야, 한국어 배운 지 얼마나 됐어요?

translations.en: Emma, how long have you been learning Korean?
It's been a year now!
I'm still in the middle of learning.
Still, I'm gradually getting better.
I'm almost there now!
You've really improved a lot!
Emma, what style do you like?
How about this dress?
It really suits you!
Is this color trendy these days?
Do I look like a model?
I'll take this one!
Let's order delivery today!
How long does delivery take?
Thirty minutes! I ordered it in advance.
Wow, it's here already!

speaker: emma
korean: 이 양에 이 가격이면 가성비 좋아요!

translations.en: This much for this price is great value!
Let's order again next time!
How's life in Korea?
So much has happened.
The longer I live here, the more I like it.
My Korean has become a lot more natural too.
I'm used to it now.
Let's make the next six months good too!
It's two stops from here.
So we take Line 2?
It's pitch dark outside!
That's because this part is underground.
Please stand back from the safety line.
Do we get off at Hongik University?
Let's grab a taxi here!
Let me try saying it.
Please take us to Gyeongbokgung.
Oh, not bad!
The sundubu jjigae here is really famous.
It smells great already!
I'll go with the sundubu jjigae.
Could you make it less spicy?
It's just right! Only a little spicy.
Can I get a refill on this side dish?
Yes, side dishes are self-serve!
I'll take the leftovers to go.
Next time let's try the spicy one.
Emma, what are you doing this weekend?
Nothing yet!
Want to watch a movie with Sophie?
Sounds good! What time shall we meet?
I think I'll be a little late!
Emma! Over here!
Take your time!
I came as soon as class ended.
Sorry, I took the wrong subway.
Next time let's meet at my place!
Sounds great!
Where am I? I'm completely lost.
Excuse me, I'm lost.
How do I get to Gyeongbokgung?
Just go straight down this road.
At the end there, turn left.
I understood! Now let's go see Gyeongbokgung.
Wow, it's huge!
I found it on my own.
Emma, what are you watching these days?
Nothing at the moment.
Jisu, have you watched this drama?
I watched it twice! It's the real deal.
Whoa... this is so much fun!
I should tell Sophie about this too.
Jisu, I totally recommend this drama!
I'm the one who recommended it!
Jisu, how's the weather tomorrow?
They say it'll get colder.
I think it's going to snow!
It's already snowing.
The cherry blossoms are out!
Walking while looking at the flowers is wonderful.
They say it's 30 degrees today.
That must be really hot!
The sunset is beautiful.
I've seen all four seasons in Korea.
My head hurts. Let me go to a pharmacy.
My throat hurts — do you have cold medicine?
This makes you drowsy. You mustn't drive.

speaker: pharmacist
korean: 커피랑 같이 안 먹는 게 나아요.

translations.en: It's better not to take it with coffee.
Understood. Thank you!
I heard about this from Sophie — it really is convenient.
Minjun, what's your hobby?
Photography. I go shooting every weekend.
Me too! I like photography as well.
But indoor photos aren't really my thing.
Same here. Outside is much better.
Let's go shooting together next week.
Sounds great!
What's famous here?
That gate is the most famous.
I'll take a picture for you!
Let's take a photo together!

speaker: emma
korean: 이거 예쁘다. 할머니께서 좋아하실 것 같아요.

translations.en: This is pretty. I think my grandmother would like it.
How about this one?
Then I'll take this one.
Did the photo come out well?
Perfect!
Emma! Is that really you?
It's been so long!
How have you been?
Yeah, I've been good. You?
It's already been a year since we met.
See you again soon!

speaker: emma
korean: 저 이번 학기에 계획을 세우려고 해요.

translations.en: I'm planning to set some goals for this semester.
Oh, what do you want to do?
I want to write a Korean diary every day.
Then write it down here.
I've decided to write three sentences a day!
I'm definitely going to stick to it!
Let's do it together! Fighting!
Lately I keep putting things off.
I've decided to work out every morning.
Oh, really? That's impressive!
This time I've really made up my mind.
I've improved compared to before!
Just keep it up!
This is sundae. Give it a try.
It was better than I expected...
Wow! Now that I've tried it, it's really good!
Sophie recommended it to me.
Sophie really likes this too, I noticed.
Next time I'll be the one recommending!
Today let's do English and Korean together!
Please tell me how to read this.
You write it like this. Right?
You learned this expression last time, remember?
Ah, right! I remember now!
Today we're making kimchi jjigae!
I already sliced the tofu.
How much kimchi do I put in?
Just one cup is enough.
I made it all by myself!
It's really good! Well done!
There are so many clothes here!
How about this one?
It suits you!
I'm going to buy this.

speaker: sophie
korean: 현금이 만 원밖에 없어서 카드로 할게요.

translations.en: I only have ten thousand won in cash, so I'll pay by card.
We really bought a lot!
Today was the best!
I started working here!
This is how you speak to customers.
Wow, that's so cool!
Welcome. Would you like to order?
Here's your americano. Please enjoy.
I'll bring it to your seat.
I want to work part-time someday too!
My stomach has been hurting since morning.
I'd like to see a doctor.
Where does it hurt?
Since when has it been hurting?
Since yesterday evening.

speaker: doctor
korean: 며칠은 매운 거 드시면 안 돼요.

translations.en: You mustn't eat spicy food for a few days.
Take it three times a day, after meals.
I feel like I can breathe again.
It's so quiet here.

speaker: sophie
korean: 저 여기 와 봤어요! 공부하기 좋아요.

translations.en: I've been here before! It's great for studying.
That window seat is empty.
It's not as hard as I thought!
I should come here again.

speaker: minjun
korean: 한국 음식 중에 뭐가 제일 좋아?

translations.en: Which Korean food do you like best?
Tteokbokki! It's spicy, which makes it addictive.
It's really different from American food.

speaker: emma
korean: 저는 빵 대신에 밥을 먹게 됐어요.

translations.en: I've come to eat rice instead of bread.
You're totally Korean now!
This expression feels a bit off...
This really confuses me.
Me too. Can I be honest?
Nuance really is a difficult thing.
It's not that it's wrong — the feeling is different.
I wonder if I was overthinking it.
I think I get it now!
Overtime again today...
Minjun, how are things lately?
I'm busy because of a project.
I stayed up all night writing a report.
Please don't push yourself too hard.
Thanks. I should rest a bit now.
The coffee's on me!
Sophie, do you use social media a lot?
This is what's trending lately!
You have to photograph the food first!
I posted a photo yesterday and my followers went up!
I was startled because I got tagged out of nowhere.
You're an influencer now!
Today I'm taking on bulgogi!
Do you have the ingredients?
Huh? I used up all the sugar!
Still, let's give it a shot.
Wow, this is really good!
I'll do even better next time!
I've ended up with so many cosmetics.
Emma, do you have a routine?
Yes! After washing my face, I start with toner.

speaker: emma
korean: 마스크팩은 자기 전에 하고 나서 자요.

translations.en: I do a sheet mask before bed, then sleep.
You absolutely have to do this every day!
My skin has really improved!
Korean is really fun these days!
Emma, you've really improved a lot!
What's the secret? I want to know too.
But I get confused between "haseyo" and "hae."
You improve as much as you put in. Don't worry!
I'll work even harder!
The cherry blossoms are already out!
The petals are flying like snow!
Look here! They're all in bloom!
Summer is so hot!

speaker: emma
korean: 더워도 밖에 나올 텐데, 다들 대단해요.

translations.en: Even in this heat people still come out — everyone's amazing.
No matter how hot it is, you have to see the sunset!
I love all four seasons.
Did I say that too harshly the other day...
I felt a little hurt back then.
I thought you were angry.
That's not what I meant, you see.
I should have said something right away.
It's fine now. Thanks for telling me.
Emma, what's your dream?
I want to become an interpreter.
Someday I'll say this in an interview.

speaker: emma
korean: 저는 두 나라를 잇는 사람이 되겠습니다.

translations.en: I will become someone who connects two countries.
Sometimes I want to give up.
But just keep going. I'm rooting for you!
Where am I supposed to throw this away?
For plastic bottles, peel off the label before tossing it.
Is it not okay to leave the label on?
Then this tumbler is the only answer!
I should start paying more attention now.
Take a photo so you don't get confused!
Great idea!
The night view is so beautiful.
This is exactly the feeling.
I like things calm, like the sea at night.
Every time I come here, I feel at ease.
This is our first time talking like this.

speaker: emma
korean: 이런 순간이 오래 남을 것 같다.

translations.en: I think this moment will stay with me.
Something's become awkward.
I was a bit taken aback that day.

speaker: emma
korean: 저는 지수 씨가 화난 줄 알았어요.

translations.en: I thought you were angry.
It would have been better if I'd just asked.

speaker: emma
korean: 그 말을 듣고서 계속 마음에 걸렸어요.

translations.en: After hearing that, it kept bothering me.

speaker: jisu
korean: 앞으론 바로 말하자. 오해가 생기더라도 괜찮아.

translations.en: From now on let's say things right away. Even if there's a misunderstanding, it's fine.
Thank you. I feel relieved.
The results are out...
I passed!
I finally did it!
That's amazing!

speaker: minjun
korean: 매일 그렇게 하기에 될 줄 알았어.

translations.en: You worked at it every day, so I knew you'd make it.
It's all thanks to you. I can't help but be grateful.
This is Gwangjang Market!
This is huge!
Wow, it's way crispier than I expected!

speaker: jisu
korean: 이거 한번 먹어 봐. 진짜 중독성 있어.

translations.en: Try this. It's seriously addictive.
I ate so well today!
I really love this alley.
That's the cafe that just opened!
Let's go there!
I like walking around like this.
Every time I come here, I'm happy.
These ordinary days are precious.
What's the difference between "masisseoyo" and "masinneyo"?
The meaning is the same, but the feeling is different.
The more I learn, the harder it gets!

speaker: emma
korean: 저는 규칙만큼 느낌이 중요한 줄 몰랐어요.

translations.en: I didn't know feeling matters as much as rules.

speaker: jisu
korean: 외우는 대신에 많이 들어 봐. 그거뿐이야!

translations.en: Instead of memorizing, just listen a lot. That's all there is to it!
It's great having everyone together!

speaker: minjun
korean: 저기가 우리 처음 만났을 때 그 자리야.

translations.en: That's the spot where we first met.
I was so nervous that day!
It's all thanks to you.
I even bragged about you to my parents!
I'll remember this sunset for a long time.
Emma, how long will you stay in Korea?
Honestly, I haven't decided yet.

speaker: emma
korean: 통역사가 되기 위해 더 공부하고 싶어요.

translations.en: I want to study more in order to become an interpreter.

speaker: emma
korean: 부모님은 걱정하실 텐데, 그래도 해 보고 싶어요.

translations.en: My parents will worry, but I still want to try.
I'll help you, so don't worry.
There are so many people!
You have to queue here.

speaker: emma
korean: 이렇게 기다리는 거 보니까 진짜 유명한가 봐요.

translations.en: Seeing this queue, it must really be famous.
Since we're here, let's order something else too!
With this taste, you have no choice but to wait!
Let's come again!
The presentation is over!
My hands are still shaking.
You did great!
At first I couldn't even read one line.
Now I've come to speak in front of people.
I finally did it!

speaker: emma
korean: 한국에 온 지 벌써 이만큼이나 됐네요.

translations.en: It's already been this long since I came to Korea.
We've really come a long way!
Why are you suddenly lowering your voice?

speaker: emma
korean: 지수 씨, 이거 비밀인데요. 소피 씨가 다음 학기에 한국에 온다고 했어요.

translations.en: Jisu, this is a secret. Sophie said she's coming to Korea next semester.
You can't tell anyone yet.
Huh? I heard that too. I hear Sophie's coming?

speaker: emma
korean: 네? 벌써 알고 있었어요? 저만 비밀인 줄 알았네요.

translations.en: What? You already knew? I guess I was the only one treating it as a secret.
Rumors really do travel fast.
Minjun said the exact same thing yesterday.
Minjun, the cherry blossoms are already out.

speaker: minjun
korean: 응, 이번 주가 제일 예쁠 때야.

translations.en: Yeah, this week is when they look best.

speaker: emma
korean: 저 작년엔 이 길도 몰랐어요. 이제는 혼자서도 찾아오게 됐어요.

translations.en: Last year I didn't even know this path. Now I've come to find my way here on my own.

speaker: minjun
korean: 한 곳에 오래 살다 보니까 길이 몸에 익는 거지.

translations.en: When you live in one place for a long time, the streets just sink into you.

speaker: emma
korean: 한국말도 그런 것 같아요. 어느새 많이 편해졌어요.

translations.en: I think Korean is like that too. Somewhere along the way it got much more comfortable.

speaker: emma
korean: 처음엔 어려워도, 계속하다 보면 되는 거였어요.

translations.en: Even if it's hard at first, if you keep at it, it works out.
Spring must have arrived just as slowly as this.

speaker: emma
korean: 지수 씨, 저 어제 한국어 시험 봤어요. 처음 본 것치고는 점수가 잘 나왔어요.

translations.en: Jisu, I took a Korean test yesterday. For a first try, my score came out well.

speaker: jisu
korean: 진짜? 그 시험 듣기가 어려운 편인데.

translations.en: Really? That test tends to have hard listening.

speaker: jisu
korean: 야, 너 은근히 잘해. 아무리 그래도 그 점수는 운으로 안 나와.

translations.en: Hey, you're secretly good at this. Even so, you don't get that score by luck.
Hearing you say that feels great!
I'll work hard on the next test too.
Then I'll buy the coffee.
You promised!

speaker: sophie
korean: 에마 씨, 학기 끝나면 어떻게 할 거예요?

translations.en: Emma, what are you going to do when the semester ends?
Honestly, I'm not really sure myself.

speaker: emma
korean: 돌아가야 하나 싶다가도 마음이 계속 바뀌어요.

translations.en: I wonder if I should go back, and then my mind keeps changing.

speaker: sophie
korean: 일단은 오늘 할 일부터 해요. 답은 천천히 와요.

translations.en: For now, just do today's tasks first. The answer comes slowly.
You're right. I should think about it a bit more.

speaker: sophie
korean: 그럼 다음에 만날 때 얘기해 줘요.

translations.en: Then tell me about it when we meet next time.
Okay, I'll bring an answer with me then.

speaker: minjun
korean: 여기 이거 시켜 봤는데, 매울 거야.

translations.en: I ordered this here, but it's going to be spicy.
I know. I can tell just by looking.
Just from the color, I get a feel for it now.
As you can see, even the side dishes here are all spicy.

speaker: emma
korean: 민준 씨, 눈치챘어요? 저 이제 메뉴판 안 봐도 돼요.

translations.en: Minjun, did you notice? I don't need the menu anymore.
I'm confident about Korean food now.

speaker: minjun
korean: 인정. 이제 진짜 한국 사람 다 됐네.

translations.en: Fair enough. You've really become Korean now.

speaker: jisu
korean: 여기가 내가 말한 거리야. 주말엔 사람 진짜 많아.

translations.en: This is the street I told you about. On weekends it's really packed.
Wow, it's as crowded as it looked in the photos.
That's the first time I've seen a mask like that!
As you can see, there's nothing you can't find here.

speaker: emma
korean: 저는 조용한 곳을 좋아하는 편인데, 여긴 왠지 좋아요.

translations.en: I tend to prefer quiet places, but somehow I like it here.

speaker: emma
korean: 여기서는 심심하기는커녕 시간이 너무 빨리 가요.

translations.en: Far from being bored here, time goes by way too fast.

speaker: emma
korean: 오늘도 이 도시를 조금 더 알게 됐다.

translations.en: Today I got to know this city a little more again.

speaker: sophie
korean: 에마 씨, 저는 아직도 처음 만나는 사람이 조금 부담스러워요.

translations.en: Emma, meeting someone for the first time still feels like a bit of a burden to me.

speaker: emma
korean: 저도 그랬어요. 그런데 이제 많이 편해졌어요.

translations.en: I was the same. But now I've gotten much more comfortable.
How did you get comfortable?
As I met people often, it became natural.

speaker: sophie
korean: 제가 처음에 다니던 학원도 그랬어요. 한 달 지나니까 괜찮아졌어요.

translations.en: The academy I used to attend at first was like that too. After a month it got better.
Now I'm the one who speaks first.
We've both changed a lot.

speaker: minjun
korean: 야, 너 아까 주문하는 거 완전 한국 사람 같았어.

translations.en: Hey, the way you ordered earlier, you sounded totally Korean.

speaker: emma
korean: 정말요? 저 아직 외국인 티 나요?

translations.en: Really? Can you still tell I'm a foreigner?

speaker: emma
korean: 저 이제 한국말이 편해요. 요즘은 한국어로 꿈도 꿔요.

translations.en: Korean feels comfortable to me now. These days I even dream in Korean.

speaker: emma
korean: 앗, 저 지금도 한국어로 생각하고 있었어요.

translations.en: Oh, I was thinking in Korean just now too.
You're as good as me now.
Then from today, I'll do the interpreting!

speaker: minjun
korean: 좋지. 근데 계산도 네가 하는 거야?

translations.en: Sounds good. But does that mean you're paying too?
This is it. I like local spots better than tourist spots.

speaker: emma
korean: 우와, 골목 안에 이런 데가 있었어요?

translations.en: Wow, there was a place like this inside the alley?

speaker: jisu
korean: 현지인들이 가는 곳이야. 완전 숨겨진 명소야.

translations.en: It's a place locals go to. It's a totally hidden gem.
The broth is really deep.
Since we're here, should we order sundae too?

speaker: emma
korean: 저 이런 데를 혼자서도 찾을 수 있을까요?

translations.en: Do you think I could find a place like this on my own?

speaker: emma
korean: 지도에 없는 골목이 제일 오래 기억에 남는다.

translations.en: The alleys that aren't on the map stay in my memory the longest.

speaker: emma
korean: 여기가 그 카페예요? 사진에서 본 것보다 더 예뻐요.

translations.en: Is this that cafe? It's prettier than it looked in the photos.

speaker: emma
korean: 이 카페 요즘 핫해요. 주말엔 줄 선다고 들었어요.

translations.en: This cafe is hot these days. I heard people line up on weekends.
So that's why we came on a weekday.
Flower cafes like this are totally the trend.

speaker: emma
korean: 소피 씨, 여기서 한 장 찍어요!

translations.en: Sophie, let's take one here!
Okay, one, two, three!
My account is on the rise these days too!

speaker: emma
korean: 예쁜 곳은 같이 와야 두 배가 된다.

translations.en: Pretty places double when you come with someone.

speaker: jisu
korean: 이거 봐. 다음 달에 한국어 말하기 대회 있대.

translations.en: Look at this. There's a Korean speech contest next month.
Me? Do you think I could do it?
I wonder if it's still too early for me.
If you try it, I bet it's more fun than you think.

speaker: emma
korean: 듣고 보니 할 수 있을 것 같기도 해요.

translations.en: Now that you mention it, it also feels like I might be able to do it.
Even if you don't win, the experience stays with you.
I've gotten at least a little bit of courage.
I'll help you with the application.

speaker: emma
korean: 민준 씨, 이 기사 좀 보세요. 하루에 세 시간만 자도 괜찮다는데, 앞뒤가 안 맞아요.

translations.en: Minjun, look at this article. It says three hours of sleep a day is fine, but it doesn't add up.

speaker: minjun
korean: 낮에 여러 번 나눠 자기에 가능한 거지.

translations.en: It's possible because they split it into several naps during the day.
Ah, hearing it that way, it makes sense.

speaker: minjun
korean: 근데 결국엔 밤에 푹 자는 게 제일 좋아.

translations.en: But in the end, sleeping deeply at night is the best.
Then I'll go to bed early today.
You said that last week too.
This time I mean it!
Emma, did something happen?

speaker: emma
korean: 어제 발표자 명단에서 제 이름이 빠졌어요.

translations.en: My name was left off the presenter list yesterday.
We prepared it together, but... I was really upset.

speaker: emma
korean: 아무 말도 못 하고 웃을 수밖에 없었어요. 좀 억울했어요.

translations.en: I couldn't say anything and had no choice but to smile. It felt unfair.

speaker: sophie
korean: 그럴 만해요. 참지 말고 다 말해요.

translations.en: That's understandable. Don't hold it in, say it all.
Now that I've said it out loud, I feel relieved.
Next time I'll get angry on your behalf.
Have you told your parents?

speaker: emma
korean: 아직요. 걱정하실 텐데 어떻게 말할지 모르겠어요.

translations.en: Not yet. They'll probably worry, and I don't know how to say it.

speaker: emma
korean: 부모님 마음은 알아요. 그래도 저는 더 있고 싶어요.

translations.en: I understand how they feel. Still, I want to stay longer.
Even if they're against it, you should tell them what you think.
You're right. I'll try calling tonight.
If it's hard, I'll stay by your side for you.
Having you here makes me feel secure.
This scene... is scary.
I'm completely absorbed right now.
There's a twist starting from here!
Wait, don't tell me!
Whoa... that person was the culprit?

speaker: sophie
korean: 저도 처음 볼 때 진짜 놀랐어요.

translations.en: I was really shocked when I first saw it too.
The last scene stayed in my memory for a long time, I found.
Me too. The feeling still lingers.
The breeze is nice today.
When I come here, my mind gets quiet.

speaker: emma
korean: 오늘은 이 불빛이 왠지 모르게 다르게 보여요.

translations.en: Today these lights somehow look different to me.
Minjun, do you know this feeling?
I do. I feel the same when I come here.

speaker: emma
korean: 이런 건 말로 표현하기 어려워요. 한국어로도, 영어로도요.

translations.en: Something like this is hard to put into words. In Korean or in English.
I wonder if I'll come to miss nights like this.
It's already the last week.
Honestly, I don't want to leave.

speaker: jisu
korean: 나도 네가 없으면 이상할 것 같아.

translations.en: I think it'll feel strange without you too.

speaker: emma
korean: 이 강도, 이 소리도 다 그리울 것 같아요. 잊기는커녕 더 자주 생각날 거예요.

translations.en: I think I'll miss this river and these sounds. Far from forgetting, I'll think of them more often.
I'll definitely come back.

speaker: jisu
korean: 약속. 안 오면 내가 미국까지 간다.

translations.en: Promise. If you don't, I'm going all the way to America.

speaker: emma
korean: 잘 있어, 라는 말은 아직 하지 말자.

translations.en: Let's not say goodbye just yet.
The way you speak these days has definitely changed.
I feel it too. My skills have improved a lot.

speaker: emma
korean: 이제 한국어로 생각해요. 머릿속에서 영어가 먼저 안 나와요.

translations.en: I think in Korean now. English doesn't come out first in my head.

speaker: minjun
korean: 진짜? 그거 아무나 되는 거 아닌데.

translations.en: Really? That doesn't happen for just anyone.
I understand class without translating too.

speaker: emma
korean: 일 년 동안 하루도 안 빼고 해 왔어요.

translations.en: I've kept at it for a year without missing a single day.
That's exactly why you improved. That's seriously impressive.
All right, today is Emma's farewell party.
Thank you for gathering like this.
I feel truly grateful to all of you.
We had fun because of you too.

speaker: sophie
korean: 저도 에마 씨 덕분에 정말 많이 배웠어요.

translations.en: I learned so much thanks to you, Emma.

speaker: emma
korean: 우리 다 같이 성장한 것 같아요.

translations.en: I think we all grew together.
Then, cheers!
Please keep looking out for me from now on too.
It's the last night, but I'm not sad at all.
Why? I was getting ready to cry.

speaker: emma
korean: 저 다시 올 거예요. 이번엔 여행이 아니라 일하러요.

translations.en: I'm going to come back. This time not to travel, but to work.
Really? You're going to get a job here?
Hey, that means we'll meet again!

speaker: emma
korean: 한국에서 일하기 위해 준비할 게 많아요.

translations.en: There's a lot to prepare in order to work in Korea.
I'll help you, so don't worry.

speaker: emma
korean: 다음에 만날 때 더 잘하도록 열심히 할게요.

translations.en: I'll work hard so that I do even better when we meet next time.
This isn't the end — from here, it starts again.
Minjun, is there anything I can help with?
Thanks! Then let me ask you a favor.
What should I do first?

speaker: emma
korean: 저기요, 죄송한데요 혹시 주문 좀 도와주실 수 있어요?

translations.en: Excuse me, sorry to bother you — could you help me order?
Shall I order for you?
Here you go. Enjoy!
You're better at this than me now!
Emma, do you have any travel plans?

speaker: emma
korean: 제주도에서 꼭 봐야 할 게 뭐예요?

translations.en: What's a must-see in Jeju?
Seongsan Ilchulbong! That's the best spot.
How many days will you stay?
Four days and three nights!

speaker: minjun
korean: 내가 코스 짜 줄 테니 걱정 마.

translations.en: I'll plan the route, so don't worry.
I'm excited already!

speaker: emma
korean: 아, 배고프다. 편의점 음식이 그렇게 맛있대.

translations.en: Ah, I'm hungry. They say convenience store food is really good.

speaker: minjun
korean: 어, 에마! 이 유자차 시원하고 맛있어.

translations.en: Oh, Emma! This yuja tea is cold and tasty.
Then I'll go with this one.
There are so many kinds of cup noodles here.

speaker: emma
korean: 저 라면 한 번밖에 안 먹어 봤어요.

translations.en: I've only tried ramyeon once.

speaker: emma
korean: 이거 얼마나 걸려요? 여기서 먹어도 돼요?

translations.en: How long does this take? May I eat it here?
Three minutes. Let's eat by the window.
Wow, is ramyeon this good?
Convenience stores — I love them.
